endorsements.quote: Therefore, continuous post-deployment monitoring of AI performance across populations is needed to ensure the reproducibility and rigor of model results.

unlisted_practices: Design learning biomedical ecosystems in which humans and AI continuously align and co-evolve.
Dynamically calibrate AI autonomy and oversight to clinical risk, operational complexity, and societal values.

screen.reason: This is a viewpoint commentary proposing an extension to the Fundamental Theorem of Biomedical Informatics to encompass sociotechnical human-AI collaboration and governance in the AI era.
